description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllMdCellActivt]{Cell Activation Technique}.

Your healing factor is briefly supercharged. You have fast healing 5 (10 at 7th rank or higher). You recover from drained, enfeebled, and clumsy at twice the normal rate.

When this effect ends, you become fatigued for 1 hour (10 minutes if the activation was Heightened to 7th).
